# Smarter Tracks

> Smarter Tracks is tool tracking software for construction, HVAC and trades teams. Crews check tools in and out from their phones, every hand-off is logged with a timestamp and the person responsible, and managers run audits from any phone. No GPS tags, Bluetooth trackers or other hardware are required. Pricing is flat, with no per-user fees.

Key facts:
- What it does: tool check-out and check-in, custody tracking (who has each tool), transfer history, phone-based audits, tool photos, damaged-tool reporting.
- Who it's for: construction contractors, HVAC companies, and plumbing, electrical and mechanical field-service teams.
- Hardware: none required. Runs on iOS and Android phones, plus the web. Same-day setup.
- Pricing (USD):
  - Free trial: 3 users, 5 tools, no credit card
  - Starter: $185/month (15 users, 150 tools; $2,220 billed yearly)
  - Pro: $315/month (75 users, 750 tools; $3,780 billed yearly)
  - Custom plans for larger teams
  - No per-user charges, no long-term contracts
- Best for: teams that want tool accountability ("who has it, who had it last") without buying and maintaining tags.
- Not designed for: live GPS tracking of heavy equipment or vehicles.
- Founded: 2025. Over 600 tools tracked on the platform.
- Contact: brockcoburn@smartertracks.com
